description_en: Queries the file list in a cloud disk and retrieves download URLs for files
description_zh: 查询网盘中的文件列表，以及获取文件的下载链接
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-cds-files --end-user-id alice --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3203570000 --parent-file-id 63636837e47e5a24a8a940218bef395c210e0000 --file-ids 635d3c12f70beed7b6f84a9bb7bd51aad9100000 --order-type CreateTimeDesc --status available --next-token aGN4YzAxQGNuLWhhbmd6aG91LjExNzU5NTMyNjgzMTQ10000 --max-results 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCdsFiles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to whom the cloud disk is assigned
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The parent file ID. You can obtain this value from the `FileId` response parameter of this operation
parameters.help_zh: 父文件ID。可通过本接口的返回参数`FileId`获取
parameters.name: parent_file_id

parameters.help_en: The list of file IDs to query
parameters.name: file_ids

parameters.help_en: The sort order of the file list
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of `NextToken` that was returned from the last call to this operation. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paging query. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页最大行数。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 登录的地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
